t: This is Imperial College London, a public research university in South Kensington. Its story begins with Prince Albert, Queen Victoria's husband, who imagined this district as a cultural quarter of museums, colleges and the Royal Albert Hall. In 1907 two colleges, the Royal College of Science and the Royal School of Mines, merged to form Imperial. City and Guilds College joined in 1910. Edward the Seventh is named as its founder, which ties a king who reigned from 1901 to 1910 to a place devoted to science, technology and medicine.
